name: idc-qin-lung-ct
description: The Computed tomography (CT) Image data was obtained on patients diagnosed with Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) with mixed stage & histology from the H. Lee Moffitt Cancer Center and Research Institute. Scans were obtained from patients who underwent surgical resection and had corresponding pre-surgery diagnostic CTs. Please see the QIN LUNG CT page to learn more about the images and to obtain any supporting metadata for this collection.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
